notes:
Retoob TV 0.6.0 preview 1

Home shows individual feed shelves. Choose the See all card at the end of a shelf to open its complete list. Home, Feeds and full lists share the same left navigation and video cards.

Hold OK on a video for sources and notes. Supported YouTube links can supply a thumbnail when the feed omits one. Other missing artwork uses a quiet video placeholder.

Manage feeds keeps focus while opening its list. Refresh feeds stays in Settings and shows progress. Update dialog actions stay outside the scrolling message.

Adds the optional Profile B draft reader alongside existing feeds. Try the hosted Reddit pilot by adding this URL:
https://algoplay.com/retoob-feeds/pilots/profile-b/reddit-videos/feed.json

The pilot follows the existing r/videos connector and is updated by its scheduled publisher. It is an experiment and can be subscribed separately.

Install over the existing signed Retoob preview.
